steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Odysseus is the archetypal Greek hero whose intelligence (metis) is as important as his physical strength | Key Fact: The Odyssey tells the story of Odysseus's ten-year journey home (nostos) from the Trojan War | Key Fact: Odysseus's key qualities: cunning, eloquence, endurance, bravery, curiosity and leadership | Key Fact: Unlike Achilles (who chose glory and early death), Odysseus chooses survival and homecoming
